reasoning_content: I'm verifying the core functionality is working—the app serves the UI correctly and the dev authentication flow completes successfully, with the mock user and system admin role properly configured. I've also confirmed the IAM context, admin routes, and database connectivity are all responding as expected. The health check failures are all environmental and inherent to the local mock setup—Keycloak isn't running, tenant secrets are unprovisioned since the mock profile doesn't use OIDC, and the mainserver is an external service. The toolchain is consistent, so I'm confident this is a success, though I should run one final smoke test and verify the worker and database states to be thorough.
